newsitem.title: CHINA: China ICBC in deal with Internet business.
newsitem.headline: China ICBC in deal with Internet business.

text.p: The Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC) has signed an agreement with an Internet provider to collect fees from customers, a bank official said on Monday.
Internet customers of provider Beijing Hexun Co must open an account with a local ICBC branch, and the bank would transfer payment to the firm each month, he said.
The business would start first in Beijing and would later spread nationwide, he said. The deal was signed last week.
Beijing Hexun Co, set up two years ago, declined to say how many customers the firm had.
There were about 10 Internet providers in Beijing and China had a total of 100,000 registered Internet users at the end of 1996.
